## Keyword value expansions

- `position`: `abs`→`absolute`, `rel`→`relative`
- `text-transform`: `cap`→`capitalize`, `up`→`uppercase`

## Algorithmic rules

These transform values by a rule — they cannot be enumerated. Each shows a
compiler-verified input→output pair.

#### `spacing-scale` — padding, margin, width, height, gap, top/right/bottom/left, size (CSS_DIM_PROPS)

Bare number => multiply by the sizing unit. Compile-time uses 0.25rem; the runtime path (inline/dynamic values) uses the `u` unit = 4px (value*4+"px").

Source: `src/imba/dom/styles.imba (toValue, CSS_DIM_PROPS, variants.sizing)`

```imba
css p:4
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { padding: 1rem;}
```

```imba
css gap:2
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { gap: 0.5rem;
 --u_rg: 0.5rem;
 --u_cg: 0.5rem;}
```

#### `px-props` — x, y, z (CSS_PX_PROPS)

Bare number defaults to px unit.

Source: `src/imba/dom/styles.imba (CSS_PX_PROPS, CSS_DEFAULT_UNITS)`

```imba
css x:10
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af {
--t_x:0;--t_y:0;--t_rotate:0;
--t_scale:1;--t_scale-x:1;--t_scale-y:1;
transform: translate(var(--t_x),var(--t_y)) rotate(var(--t_rotate))
 scaleX(var(--t_scale-x)) scaleY(var(--t_scale-y)) scale(var(--t_scale));
}
.scope-af { --t_x: 10 !important;}
```

#### `rotate-unit` — rotate

Bare number defaults to turn.

Source: `src/imba/dom/styles.imba (CSS_DEFAULT_UNITS)`

```imba
css rotate:0.5
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af {
--t_x:0;--t_y:0;--t_rotate:0;
--t_scale:1;--t_scale-x:1;--t_scale-y:1;
transform: translate(var(--t_x),var(--t_y)) rotate(var(--t_rotate))
 scaleX(var(--t_scale-x)) scaleY(var(--t_scale-y)) scale(var(--t_scale));
}
.scope-af { --t_rotate: 0.5 !important;}
```

#### `radius-scale` — border-radius (rd)

Bare number => multiply by 2px (variants.radius.NUMBER). Named scale also available.

Source: `src/compiler/theme.mjs (variants.radius)`

```imba
css rd:2
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { border-radius: 4px;}
```

```imba
css rd:md
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { border-radius: 4px;}
```

#### `letter-spacing-scale` — letter-spacing (ls)

Bare number => multiply by 0.05em.

Source: `src/compiler/theme.mjs (variants[letter-spacing])`

```imba
css ls:2
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { letter-spacing: 0.1em;}
```

#### `custom-units` — any dimension value with an unknown unit

Unknown unit => calc(var(--u_{unit},1px) * value). Declare with `1{unit}:value` which sets --u_{unit}.

Source: `src/imba/dom/styles.imba (toValue else-branch)`

```imba
css 1fh:24px
    h:2fh
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { --u_fh: 24px;
 height: calc(var(--u_fh,1fh) * 2);}
```

#### `palette-color` — any color value (c, bg, bc, ...)

family+shade => hsla(). Runtime resolves via CSS_COLORS; alpha via /NN; fractional shades interpolate nearest.

Source: `src/imba/dom/styles.imba (CSS_COLORS, CSS_COLORS_REGEX, toValue)`

```imba
css bg:blue5
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { background: hsla(217.22,91.22%,59.80%,100%);}
```

```imba
css bg:blue5/50
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { background: hsla(217.22,91.22%,59.80%,50%);}
```

#### `smart-border` — border (bd), outline (ol)

Style keyword is auto-inserted. bd:1px blue5 => 1px solid <blue5>; bd:blue5 => 1px solid <blue5>.

Source: `src/compiler/styler.mjs (StyleTheme border/outline)`

```imba
css bd:1px blue5
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { border: 1px solid hsla(217.22,91.22%,59.80%,100%);}
```

#### `compound-display` — display (d)

Compound values expand to several properties (see the `layouts` section for the full resolved map).

Source: `src/compiler/styler.mjs (layouts)`

```imba
css d:hcc
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { display: flex;
 flex-direction: row;
 justify-content: center;
 align-items: center;
 align-content: center;}
```

#### `font-size-with-line-height` — font-size (fs)

fs:<size>/<lh> sets font-size and line-height together. A unitless <lh> is resolved to a computed px line-height by the compiler (see css_actual); a unit like 1.5em is passed through verbatim.

Source: `src/compiler/styler.mjs (StyleTheme.fs)`

```imba
css fs:24px/1.2
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af { font-size: 24px;
 line-height: 30px;
 --u_lh: 30px;}
```

#### `string-props-autoquote` — content, prefix, suffix (CSS_STR_PROPS)

Unquoted string values are auto-quoted. `prefix`/`suffix` also generate ::before/::after content.

Source: `src/imba/dom/styles.imba (CSS_STR_PROPS, toValue)`

```imba
css prefix:"x"
```
→ compiled CSS (verified):
```css
.scope-af::before { content: "x";}
```

### Tokens

**Color families** (shades 0 (lightest) .. 9 (darkest)): `rose`, `pink`, `fuchsia`, `purple`, `violet`, `indigo`, `blue`, `sky`, `cyan`, `teal`, `emerald`, `green`, `lime`, `yellow`, `amber`, `orange`, `red`, `warmer`, `warm`, `gray`, `cool`, `cooler`

Alpha: `blue5/50 => 50% opacity; blue5/$var => dynamic alpha`. Fractional: `blue55 => 50% between blue5 and blue6 (HSL interpolation of nearest shades)`. Specials: `black`, `white`, `transparent`, `clear`, `current (currentColor)`. Plus 148 CSS named colors.

**Font stacks:** `sans`, `serif`, `mono`

**Named font sizes:** `xxs`=10px, `xs`=12px, `sm-`=13px, `sm`=14px, `md-`=15px, `md`=16px, `lg`=18px, `xl`=20px, `2xl`=24px, `3xl`=30px, `4xl`=36px, `5xl`=48px, `6xl`=64px (numeric `1`–`16` also available)

**Radius:** `full`=9999px, `xxs`=1px, `xs`=2px, `sm`=3px, `md`=4px, `lg`=6px, `xl`=8px, `NUMBER`=2px

**Box-shadow scale:** `xxs`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `xxl`, `inner`, `outline`, `none`

**Easings:** sine-in, sine-out, sine-in-out, quad-in, quad-out, quad-in-out, cubic-in, cubic-out, cubic-in-out, quart-in, quart-out, quart-in-out, quint-in, quint-out, quint-in-out, expo-in, expo-out, expo-in-out, circ-in, circ-out, circ-in-out, back-in, back-out, back-in-out

### Modifiers

Modifiers attach **inline after a value**: `css bg:blue5 @hover:blue6`.

**Shimmable pseudo-classes** (compile to `:is(:x, .\@x)` so flags can toggle them): `@active`, `@checked`, `@disabled`, `@enabled`, `@focin`, `@focus`, `@focus-visible`, `@hover`, `@indeterminate`, `@invalid`, `@optional`, `@required`, `@valid`

**Other pseudo-classes:** `@autofill`, `@default`, `@defined`, `@empty`, `@first-child`, `@first-of-type`, `@focus-within`, `@fullscreen`, `@in-range`, `@lang`, `@last-child`, `@last-of-type`, `@left`, `@link`, `@modal`, `@nth-child`, `@nth-last-child`, `@nth-last-of-type`, `@nth-of-type`, `@only-child`, `@only-of-type`, `@out-of-range`, `@paused`, `@picture-in-picture`, `@placeholder-shown`, `@playing`, `@read-only`, `@read-write`, `@right`, `@root`, `@scope`, `@target`, `@target-within`, `@user-invalid`, `@visited`, `@where`

**Pseudo-elements:** `@-webkit-resizer`, `@-webkit-scrollbar`, `@-webkit-scrollbar-button`, `@-webkit-scrollbar-corner`, `@-webkit-scrollbar-thumb`, `@-webkit-scrollbar-track`, `@-webkit-scrollbar-track-piece`, `@after`, `@backdrop`, `@before`, `@cue`, `@cue-region`, `@first-letter`, `@first-line`, `@marker`, `@placeholder`, `@selection`

**Breakpoints:**

| Modifier | Media |
|---|---|
| `@xs` | (min-width: 480px) (neg: (max-width: 479px)) |
| `@sm` | (min-width: 640px) (neg: (max-width: 639px)) |
| `@md` | (min-width: 768px) (neg: (max-width: 767px)) |
| `@lg` | (min-width: 1024px) (neg: (max-width: 1023px)) |
| `@xl` | (min-width: 1280px) (neg: (max-width: 1279px)) |
| `@2xl` | (min-width: 1536px) |
| `@lt-xs` | (max-width: 479px) |
| `@lt-sm` | (max-width: 639px) |
| `@lt-md` | (max-width: 767px) |
| `@lt-lg` | (max-width: 1023px) |
| `@lt-xl` | (max-width: 1279px) |
| `@lt-2xl` | (max-width: 1535px) |

**Media/feature:** `@print`, `@screen`, `@speech`, `@all`, `@landscape`, `@portrait`, `@dark`, `@light`, `@standalone`, `@browser`

**Runtime state flags** (class selectors toggled by Imba): `@enter`, `@leave`, `@darky`, `@lighty`, `@touch`, `@suspended`, `@move`, `@hold`, `@ssr`

**Priority:** `@inline` (3), `@important` (4), `@force` (6)

Any undefined @modifier compiles to a class selector .\@modifier (custom state flag). Shimmable pseudo-classes compile to :is(:x, .\@x) so they can be toggled via flags.

### DOM / runtime mechanisms

The real "DOM impact" is this small fixed set — not a per-property fact:

- **scope-class** — Static CSS => stylesheet rule applied via an auto-generated scope class. No per-property DOM effect beyond the class.
- **dynamic-var** — Inline [] / dynamic values => a CSS custom property set at runtime via element.style.setProperty (css$var). Final CSS is computed in the browser (see runtime rules).
- **transform-composite** — x/y/z/rotate/scale/skew each set a CSS variable; a single composite `transform` rule is auto-injected that references them.
- **ease-cascade** — ea/es/eo/ec/eb/et set cascading easing variables (duration/function/delay) that transitions read from.
- **color-decomposition** — #color definitions decompose into --u_{name}L/C/H/A variables (LCH); var-to-var #color refs resolve at definition level and do NOT cascade.
- **pseudo-shim** — Shimmed pseudo-classes compile to :is(:hover, .\@hover) so they can be toggled via flags/classes at runtime.

### Gotchas (verified counterexamples)

**`inset:0`** — inset:* ALSO sets position:absolute

```css
.scope-af { position: absolute;
 top: 0rem;
 right: 0rem;
 bottom: 0rem;
 left: 0rem;}
```

**`d:block!`** — the ! priority suffix is NOT valid Imba CSS

```text
compile error: Unexpected 'UNARY'
```

**`fs:24px/1.2`** — slash sets line-height, not division

```css
.scope-af { font-size: 24px;
 line-height: 30px;
 --u_lh: 30px;}
```
